claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemComponentMechanics.ongoing_effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a real magic-item activation that creates a timed persistent aura over an area. Current magic-item mechanics only allow passive grants or immediate activation phases; they cannot honestly encode a planted aura with ongoing area-scoped effects and a later manual end action.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws and can sense the location of any Invisible creature that is also in the Bright Light."

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_rod_of_alertness.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
